title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E03 — Neanderthal Bigfoot Attack
A close encounter with an enraged ape-like creature is caught on camera, experts investigate if it's evidence of a once-extinct Neanderthal specimen engineered by a nearby experimental research facility.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E02 — Alien Evidence: The Holy Grail
When a powerful radio beam originating from deep space is detected by experts on Earth, some suspect it's hard evidence of extraterrestrial life; new investigations into this shocking signal might reveal the truth.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E01 — Curse of the Lost Cosmonaut
When two experts build their own radio-listening station to intercept the secret communications of American and Soviet astronauts, they capture traces of a haunting voice that may be a lost Russian cosmonaut.

title: Killers of the Cosmos
description:
S01 E03 — Cosmic Scrap
More than 100 million pieces of small space debris are floating around the Earth; a collision between two of these objects in low Earth orbit could be catastrophic.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E02 — Aliens vs. Stalin at Area 51
When a former Area 51 insider alleges that the Roswell UFO incident was a nefarious Soviet conspiracy masterminded by Stalin, experts investigate if it was indeed an enemy plot against America -- or if the confession is just another cover-up.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E06 — Secrets of the Alien Signals
When NASA begins a strange experiment to communicate with dolphins, experts investigate if it's a prelude to making alien contact; some fear that such a discovery could have apocalyptic consequences.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S11 E01 — The Moons of Saturn
With more than 80 moons, Saturn could rank among the most dynamic planetary system in Sol's neighborhood; with its giant underground oceans and protective magnetic fields, experts explore how Saturn's moons offer new insight into the Solar System.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S10 E04 — Hunt for Dark Matter
Dark Matter is thought to be the cosmic glue that holds the universe together, yet the search for it continues to eluded scientists today.

description:
S11 E02 — A Robot's Guide to Mars
Mars is infested with robots, orbiting the planet and roaming the Martian surface on a mission to uncover its secrets; now, Perseverance joins this dedicated group of machines to uncover if there is, or was ever, life on the Red Planet.

description:
S06 E07 — The Quasar Engima
Quasars are the brightest and most powerful objects in the universe, and though they have shaped the cosmos, they might ultimately destroy everything that exists.

description:
S02 E08 — Lady Be Good Wreck
Dig up a mysterious WW II bomber in the Libyan desert, then see why the carved pillars in a Turkish temple may be the world's oldest calendar; open a secret filled shrine in Jerusalem and unearth broken Iraqi bowls that have deep political meaning.

description:
S02 E05 — Drowned Stone Age Fisherman
Scan the skeleton of a drowned Stone Age fisherman in Chile and rediscover a vanished golden age in Egypt's lost city of Aten; ancient Chinese mummies reignite a cultural debate; discover a massive biblical-era moat in Jerusalem.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E01 — The Atacama \"Alien\" Skeleton
Examine a tiny skeleton in Chile that set off a firestorm of alien speculation; explore a forgotten Silk Road settlement; uncover evidence of a mass sacrifice in northern Peru and visit a multi-faceted military site from the age of the pharaohs.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
Hidden Temple of Athribis and Ice Age Footprints
From a forgotten Egyptian temple carved into desert cliffs to one of the world's oldest ritual hunting sites in Jordan, discoveries are redefining spiritual, cultural and migration histories.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
Million Mummy Necropolis and the Enigmatic Horseshoe
From a cemetery in Egypt to ancient bones on a Welsh beach, ancient burial sites illuminate forgotten lives and long-lost cultural shifts.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E07 — Screaming Mummy and Chaco Canyon Highway
Ponder the fate of a mummy buried with an anguished look on its face; learn the secret to Sumerian power in a buried Iraqi palace; visit a lost oasis that may rewrite Arabian history; travel New Mexican roads that align with the heavens.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:

Inspect a Mongolian mass grave and learn the fate of a platoon of soldiers, then investigate a 5,000-year-old tavern in Iraq; examine an Egyptian scarab that's far from home and ancient tools that show where desert migration routes once lay.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:

Look inside the lost tomb of King Thutmose II and get new clues about Egypt's pharaohs; dust off stone hunting structures in Saudi Arabia; visit a 1,200-year-old mosque buried in the Negev Desert and inspect a 30-million-year-old predator skull.
